title: Masked diffusion LLMs can use EoS tokens for hidden reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2603.05197v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion LLMs have been proposed as an alternative to autoregressive LLMs. Curiously, they are especially capable if the generation length, i.e., the number of tokens the model has to output, is set to a much higher value than the correct answer length, and the model pads its answer with end-of-sequence (EoS) tokens. We hypothesize that off-the-shelf masked diffusion LLMs use the representations of EoS tokens as additional computing capacity, which enhances their performance. We experiment with the diffusion models LLaDA1.5, LLaDA2.0-mini, and Dream-v0 on three reasoning tasks: Addition, Entity Tracking, and Sudoku. translated_title: 掩码扩散大语言模型可利用EoS令牌进行隐藏推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.05197v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：扩散大语言模型已被提出作为自回归大语言模型的替代方案。有趣的是，当生成长度（即模型必须输出的令牌数量）被设置为远高于正确答案长度，并且模型用序列结束（EoS）令牌填充其答案时，它们表现得尤为出色。我们假设现成的掩码扩散大语言模型将EoS令牌的表示用作额外的计算能力，从而增强其性能。我们在三个推理任务上对扩散模型LLaDA1.5、LLaDA2.0-mini和Dream-v0进行了实验：加法、实体追踪和数独。在受控提示实验中，我们确认添加EoS令牌能提高大语言模型的性能。为了进一步验证其表示是否用于隐藏计算，我们进行了因果干预，在生成之间转移EoS令牌的隐藏状态，这提高了模型的相对性能。
tldr: 本文发现掩码扩散大语言模型通过利用序列结束（EoS）令牌的表示作为额外计算资源，在推理任务中性能提升，并通过因果干预实验验证了这一隐藏计算机制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that masked diffusion LLMs leverage end-of-sequence (EoS) token representations as extra computational capacity to enhance reasoning performance, verified via causal intervention experiments.
